memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.” (Galatians 6:14)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
The cross is not just a symbol to look at; it is a narrow path to walk through. Many stand and admire the cross  but from a distance. They see the sacrifice, yet refuse to surrender. They love Jesus, but do not follow Him.
To cross over toward the Cross means: from death to resurrection, from sin to holiness, from bondage to the blessing of freedom.
On Golgotha, Jesus hung between two thieves.
One hardened his heart, rejected grace,
and died unchanged losing eternity. The other crossed through the path of the cross with repentance and faith and entered Paradise that very day with Jesus.
The cross was the same, but their hearts decided their eternity. If you walk through the cross of Christ by faith, you will enter through the door of grace. The blood-stained wood of Calvary
becomes a heavenly bridge for everyone who believes.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “The cross of Jesus is the only ladder that touches Heaven.” - Charles Spurgeon

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, lead my life through the way of the Cross.
Crucify my pride and my sins upon it.
Grant me grace to live a new life
under the shadow of Your sacrifice.
Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May your path always pass through the Cross.
May the victory of Golgotha echo through your life.

recommended_book.label: Recommended Book
recommended_book.title: “The Cross of Christ”
recommended_book.author: John Stott
recommended_book.quote: “Our redemption is a work at once of price and of power of expiation and of conquest. On the cross the purchase was made, and on the cross the victory was won. The blood that cancels our guilt was shed there, and the death that dealt a death-blow to Satan’s kingdom was endured there…”
